entries.text: 只要好朋友叫我，\n我就会全速赶来！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_first_01

entries.text: 虽然我是脑子一热就来了，\n不过蓝莓学园还真厉害啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_00

entries.text: 教学内容也是像对战学那样\n着重于战斗的课程更多。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_01

entries.text: 要是妮莫的话肯定乐开花了。\n不过我个人还是更想学家政这种……\r\n实用的课程啊～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_02

entries.text: 如果要学的话，\n你会选哪边？\r\n对战学吗？还是家政课？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_03

entries.text: 对战学！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 家政课！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 这么一说，我都差点忘了。\n你也是对战不输妮莫的\r\n最强冠军啊……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04

entries.text: 哦！和我一样呀！\c\n毕竟只要努力学习家政课，\n做出的三明治也会变得很好吃啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04b

entries.text: 校长之前说过，\n如果在这边学习的话，\r\n可以多给一些学院的学分！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_05

entries.text: 我的学分不够，所以想努力\n试试在这里多赚点学分！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_06

entries.text: 在蓝莓学园这里，\n野餐时做三明治的人\r\n是不是比较小众啊？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_01

entries.text: 是这样吗！？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 怎么会……
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 你说在四天王挑战……\n被要求制作超辣三明治了？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_02

entries.text: ……这么说来，\n大概是我误会了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_03

entries.text: 虽然这么说，但之前我在巨蛋\n做料理的时候，不知不觉间\r\n就被蓝莓学园的人围住了……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_04

entries.text: 那群家伙用一脸超～级稀奇的\n表情盯着看，我特别难为情……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_05

entries.text: 不知怎的，最后就变成了\n我请他们所有人吃三明治……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_06

entries.text: 真好啊～！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 你人真好！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 不，一点都不好！\n……啊，吃到三明治的人？你说他们啊。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07

entries.text: 不，一点都不好！\n我只是没能顶住压力而已！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07b

entries.text: 如果说三明治不稀奇的话，\n事情为什么会变成那样啊？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_08

entries.text: 蓝莓学园……\n可真是不简单呀。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_09

entries.text: 就是之前那个……派帕哥我\n被蓝莓学园的学生围住的事件！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_01

entries.text: 事情的真相……\n据说是他们认错人了！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_02

entries.text: 怎么回事？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 认错成了谁……！？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 呃，我也\n不是很清楚……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_03

entries.text: 听说是有个人会在巨蛋里\n定期发放超辣三明治，\r\n他们把我错认成那个人了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_04

entries.text: 大家都用期待的眼神看着我，\n我当时就觉得奇怪来着。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_05

entries.text: 不过话说回来……定期发放\n超辣三明治的人是怎么回事啊？\r\n他好像还被大家叫做“超辣大神”呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_06

entries.text: 好像有头绪……！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 怎么回事呢……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 说了半天，原来是你的熟人啊！\n看来这个学园也有怪家伙呀！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07

entries.text: 被错认的那一方可承受不来啊。\n看来这个学园也有怪家伙呀！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07b

entries.text: 对了，说起怪家伙……\n我想给你看看这个家伙！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_00

entries.text: 它是一只特性\n有点怪的贪心栗鼠……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_01

entries.text: 机会难得，\n我们就来交换宝可梦吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_02

entries.text: 好的！那么\n我就拿贪心栗鼠来交换！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你要用哪只来交换？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_03

entries.text:
哦哦！[VAR 0x0101(0001)]呀！
这宝可梦很有你的风格嘛！\c
我和獒教父它们
一定会让它幸福的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那就拿你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的贪心栗鼠交换咯？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_03

entries.text: 要是同行宝可梦\n只有１只可没法交换啊。\r\n拜托你带着２只以上再来找我啦。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_00

entries.text: 哦？不交换了吗？\n要是你下定决心就再来找我吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_01

entries.text: 哦！？果然还是\n要交换宝可梦吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_04_00

entries.text: 獒教父它\n很想和你对战！\r\n可以的话能陪我打一场吗？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_talkto_00

entries.text: 毕竟感觉你很忙啊……我知道了！\c\n我会把情况告诉獒教父的，\n你不用介意啦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_cancel_00

entries.text: 好！那就这么定啦！\n干劲满满地来打一场吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 69]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 你的状态还是超级好啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 为了能不输给你，\n我其实也已经锻炼过一番了啊～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 话说，我在机场买了\n几个有意思的手机壳。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 在店里看到这些手机壳的时候，\n我的眼前就浮现出了你的脸。\r\n所以就作为礼物！送你啦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]从派帕那里
获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手机壳（番茄）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、\c
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手机壳（培根）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]和
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手机壳（水果）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_reward_00

entries.text: 虽然输了，\n但獒教父它很满足！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 哦哦！撞大运打赢你了！\n这就是所谓的“猴怪也会摔下树”吗？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
我在巨蛋里看海的时候，
有只正在游泳的原野水母吓了我一跳！\c
那家伙好像是别的宝可梦，
但它们长得超像啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
在北上乡吃的
花瓣冰淇淋真好吃啊。\c
要说起这里的食堂，
学园比萨相当不错哦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你妈妈
做的饭真好吃啊～\c
下次让我也
尝尝你做的三明治嘛。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n经常会和獒教父一起玩呢！\r\n多谢你把这个好伙伴交换给我！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
有一天，藏饱栗鼠
带来了一个蛋。\c
从那里面孵出来的就是交换给你的
贪心栗鼠这个贪吃鬼哦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_04
